smb.name: The Orchard Repairs desk
smb.brief: Win a small service desk with external calling and digital enquiries. Keep the activation bill inside the owner’s budget, then protect eight-minute response promises when a carrier outage arrives.

enterprise.name: Canopy Group coexistence
enterprise.brief: Migrate a mixed estate in stages. Keep current identities and calling available while one occupied meeting room is upgraded; the migration wave consumes provider engineers that would otherwise repair faults.

government.name: Civic Grove permitted workload
government.brief: Serve a scoped public-service workload using eligible regional processing, encryption keys, retention and delegated support. Availability evidence is workload-specific; geography alone does not satisfy the brief.

defence.name: Wattle disconnection exercise
defence.brief: Keep administrative calling and retained work available during a scheduled external disconnection. Local identity, licensing, time and service dependencies consume deployment and support capacity; reconcile retained work after reconnection.

swift.name: Swift Start
swift.description: Lower entry cost and short lead times; carrier and partner terms cost more each period and leave less room for a later outage.

steady.name: Steady Route
steady.description: Higher setup commitment and longer provisioning, with lower recurring carrier and partner charges and more capacity headroom.

operations.name: Funded repair
operations.description: Restore the observed failed carrier, meeting, processing or connectivity dependency using a funded engineering job.

operations.name: Scoped incident diagnosis
operations.description: Reserve engineering and support time to examine the selected incident. The result may identify an observed outage or disconnection, or remain inconclusive. Repair and mitigation require their own decisions. Public symptoms remain free to inspect.

operations.name: Capacity mitigation
operations.description: Repair the affected dependency and reserve one additional unit of its capacity, with an ongoing support commitment.

operations.name: Service expansion
operations.description: Add funded capacity before accepting the next customer.

operations.name: Meeting room fit-out
operations.description: Provision a room endpoint and calendar path; meeting occupancy remains a separate admitted resource.

operations.name: Consent and recording
operations.description: Add consent-aware capture and retained archive capacity for eligible voice work.

operations.name: Permitted transcription
operations.description: Fund processing, permitted storage and an eligible local language model path.

operations.name: Local services deployment
operations.description: Provision local identity, time, licensing and support dependencies before disconnecting.

operations.name: Costed staff coaching
operations.description: Coach a named BPO cover worker in advanced service for four minutes. That person is unavailable during the course; the shared treasury pays once.

operations.name: Recorded quality review
operations.description: Assign an eligible reviewer to actual consented recording evidence.

operations.name: Scoped automation policy
operations.description: Fund a bounded provisioning or assurance policy with an explicit budget limit.

operations.name: Qualified BPO cover
operations.description: Purchase qualified human handling capacity under a scoped service agreement.

operations.name: After-call workflow assistance
operations.description: Fund CRM and workflow assistance to remove after-call wrap delay. Conversation duration, customer people, licences and carrier sessions remain unchanged.

operations.name: Scoped public-service procurement
operations.description: Commission a workload-specific regional processing, retention, key-custody and delegated support contract. This is a fictional scenario decision, not real authorization.

operations.name: Canopy coexistence wave
operations.description: Commission a dedicated coexistence platform, then migrate Bea’s endpoint with a retained rollback checkpoint. Existing calling continues on the old platform until cutover.

operations.name: Branch Distribution partner review
operations.description: A distributor reviews an actually qualified customer period and grants access to its supported room bundle. This fictional commercial qualification costs provider engineering and support time.

operations.name: Qualified distributor room bundle
operations.description: A qualified reseller can procure this supported room/calendar bundle through Branch Distribution: lower setup cost with a larger recurring support commitment.

operations.name: Canopy consolidated cutover
operations.description: Replace the existing platform with a dedicated shared target and migrate both identities in one wave. Eight minutes and two engineers; the old platform generation retires, with a commissioning interruption and changed platform compatibility. Lower recurring support than coexistence.

operations.name: Wattle autonomy spares
operations.description: Fund local licensing and power spares: extend the authored offline autonomy from 30 to 60 minutes. Reserves an engineer and support person; cannot repair an external connection.

operations.name: Reconcile captured records
operations.description: After reconnection, reconcile only captured service records. Unrecorded case work remains pending; synchronization never bills the same customer work again.

operations.name: Reconcile records and case work
operations.description: After reconnection, reconcile all retained captured records and case work for this customer. Costs more support time; no duplicate service revenue.

operations.name: Carrier session headroom
operations.description: Commission four additional concurrent carrier sessions after paid engineering work. Endpoint seats and customer staffing remain separate.

operations.name: Supplier-managed carrier headroom
operations.description: After earning Local UC reseller, buy four carrier sessions using supplier engineering and one provider support worker. Lower setup competes with a higher recurring commitment.

operations.name: Direct external reach
operations.description: Fund direct carrier work for two authored number aliases and scoped international calling. Higher setup and provider engineering reduce recurring exposure.

operations.name: Supplier-managed external reach
operations.description: After earning external calling operational in this market, fund supplier-managed carrier work for two authored aliases and scoped international calling. Lower setup and no provider engineering trade against higher recurring cost and longer delivery.

operations.name: Scoped local public-service processing
operations.description: Commission customer-operated capture, storage and speech with independent regional paths and finite local licence grace. Higher setup and delivery effort reduce recurring supplier exposure.

operations.name: Restore customer queue
operations.description: Restore the observed failed carrier, meeting, processing or connectivity dependency using a funded engineering job.

operations.name: Commercial service boundary review
operations.description: Fund a scoped review of the actual identity, calling and engagement paths. Resource or support changes can invalidate the reviewed boundary and require another paid review.

operations.name: Integrator-supported room service
operations.description: Twig Integrations commissions the room and its calendar path with a provider support reservation. Lower setup and shorter delivery carry a higher recurring support cost.

operations.name: Regional provisioning service
operations.description: Fund a reusable provisioning policy for explicitly selected customers in markets demonstrated by the Regional communications MSP achievement. Each order still needs its own money, staff and budget.

operations.name: Twig calling and quality integration
operations.description: Fund the fixed calling-to-quality integration with a current compatibility test, a real captured customer call and a separate paid review of that same case.

operations.name: Retest changed calling and quality integration
operations.description: Fund the fixed calling-to-quality integration with a current compatibility test, a real captured customer call and a separate paid review of that same case.

operations.name: Supplier-managed integration retest
operations.description: Fund the fixed calling-to-quality integration with a current compatibility test, a real captured customer call and a separate paid review of that same case.

operations.name: Supplier-managed calling and quality integration
operations.description: Fund the fixed calling-to-quality integration with a current compatibility test, a real captured customer call and a separate paid review of that same case.

operations.name: Increase recording capacity
operations.description: Fund four additional concurrent capture reservations. This changes recording admission without adding customer staff, carrier sessions or missing historical recordings.

operations.name: Primary inter-site service
operations.description: Fund two customer sites and a 20 Mbps primary path. The next complete demand period includes one case with two follow-up calls and a primary-path incident.

operations.name: Independent upstream
operations.description: Fund a second 20 Mbps link in an independent failure domain. Customer staffing, carrier sessions and shared sites remain separate constraints.

operations.name: Supplier-managed independent upstream
operations.description: Use earned resilience in this market to buy a lower-setup supplier-managed backup with higher recurring cost and longer delivery.

operations.name: Connect purchased endpoints
operations.description: Connect newly purchased endpoints to the existing branch. This does not add site or link capacity.

operations.name: Repair primary upstream
operations.description: Restore the acknowledged primary-path failure through a funded engineering job. Failed work remains in service history.

operations.name: Managed local autonomy spares
operations.description: Use earned local continuity in this market to buy supplier-installed autonomy spares: lower setup and no implementation engineer, with higher recurring cost and longer delivery. Extends autonomy to 60 minutes; does not repair the external connection.

operations.name: Browser guest meeting room
operations.description: A two-person browser room with external guest join and cloud media. No captions, recording or event capacity; recorded Enterprise meetings need a funded native or bridge replacement.

operations.name: National carrier headroom
operations.description: After qualifying actual wholesale service for two supported customers, fund eight additional carrier sessions for one evidenced customer. Uses provider engineering with lower recurring cost.

operations.name: Managed national carrier headroom
operations.description: Use earned wholesale qualification to buy eight carrier sessions for one evidenced customer through supplier engineering. Lower setup competes with longer delivery, provider support and higher recurring cost.

operations.name: Public-service recording reserve
operations.description: After evidenced public-service delivery, fund eight additional concurrent capture reservations within this customer's eligible boundary. Compared with two ordinary capture upgrades, this takes longer and costs more upfront, with lower recurring charges. Retention, keys, backup and permitted access stay governed by the existing scoped contract.

operations.name: Independent site calling ingress
operations.description: Commission a separately powered external calling point and independent paths to both customer sites. Carrier reach remains available when either customer building loses power.

operations.name: Owned-site administration and recovery
operations.description: Fund local administration, configuration backups and restore services at both sites. Assign the actual desk endpoints and calling identities to their buildings; each incident and migration remains a separately quoted decision.

operations.name: Fund a site recovery exercise
operations.description: Reserve the shared team for one authored site failure. Capture a backup, observe surviving calls, restore the affected configuration and verify fresh service before completion.

operations.name: Managed site recovery
operations.description: Use qualified provider support for the same scoped backup, failure and restoration work. Lower setup cost and no engineering reservation trade against a longer lead and higher recurring support.

operations.name: Move one owned-site endpoint
operations.description: Move the selected real endpoint between the two owned sites. The quote funds only that item and retains its individual migration result.

operations.name: Review retained record custody
operations.description: Fund a scoped review and permitted read of an actual processed customer record. Storage, access, key and support boundaries remain enforced.

operations.name: Integration-aware assurance policy
operations.description: Fund a reusable incident-response policy for the customers and tested product integrations in the earned integration-support milestone. Every repair remains quoted and paid; changed integrations or missing boundary evidence suspend the policy.

operations.name: Direct dedicated interconnect
operations.description: Commission an authenticated gateway using existing paid sessions. Provider engineering and higher setup reduce recurring cost; real inbound and outbound media remain required.

operations.name: Supplier-managed dedicated interconnect
operations.description: After proving dedicated interconnection in this market, buy supplier commissioning with lower setup and higher recurring cost. Existing capacity and supplier commitments remain.

operations.name: Direct case follow-up
operations.description: Prepare a paid same-case human digital follow-up after an actual voice conversation. Existing consent, handling capacity and the original deadline still apply.

operations.name: Managed case follow-up
operations.description: Prepare a paid same-case human digital follow-up after an actual voice conversation. Existing consent, handling capacity and the original deadline still apply.

operations.name: Retry case follow-up
operations.description: Prepare a paid same-case human digital follow-up after an actual voice conversation. Existing consent, handling capacity and the original deadline still apply.

operations.name: Grove and Disco room integration
operations.description: Fund eight minutes of setup, explicitly test compatibility, then deliver a real cross-platform bridge meeting. Both room products must already be funded and ready.

operations.name: Paid scale workflow and BPO handling

families.gameplayEffect: numbering and external calling consume carrier sessions
room endpoints and calendar integration gate occupied meetings
routing requires staffed handling and customer records
API workflow requires provisioned API access and identity
mission evidence is scoped to workload, region and eligibility
local service consumes compute and staffed lifecycle support
external calling depends on paid carrier reach
disconnection operation needs local support dependencies
digital cases use staffed queues; review requires retained capture
delivery uses quotas, retries, usage costs and context handoff
room path consumes room and media admission
provider operations consume fulfilment and support capacity
sovereign profiles need workload evidence and lifecycle work
transcription consumes processing, storage and permitted-path capacity

rivalPressure.description: Fictional rival bundles reduce willingness for new contracts; existing agreed terms are protected.
